title: The Guests Arrive
set_language: ONE persistent 1869 classroom table DNA: honey wood + cream-card grid that grows from desk BOARDTOP into the SAME grid as a WALL CHART. Soft lamp with NO underside bulb/shade cup. Glowing vacant seats that FILL. Same DNA every scenery plate — camera and VERB change every plate. NEVER the P04 moon-desk still-life.
continuity_lock: HARD: persist honey wood + cream cards. Do NOT I2V a run of plates from one start frame. Default T2V. Distinct mute-test framing per plate. No furniture layout reset. No room swap.
forbidden: HARD REJECT: P04 moon-desk still-life (moon LEFT window + flasks + mortar + three blank cards + lamp right); lava drip / molten bead / orange fire melt / flame / sparks / chair fire; model-town sprawl; glowing yellow house-blocks; Orbit robot; photoreal; Ken Burns only; academic-blazer Explorer; unfinished flat cards; mid-crown unfinished Explorer hair; underside lamp bulb/shade cup; layout reset; HUD wall of letters; copying P04 08 chair-walk as navigation coverage.
motion_lock: REAL Veo 3.1 camera + object motion every scenery plate. Quality for CLEAN LIGHT / emissive seats / gallium sheen. Fast only low-risk garnish. No Ken Burns hero. If Create dies — STOP.
mint_order: 01 first KEEP, then remaining. Plate-first. Assemble last.
